title: 3d Character Generator & Sculpting Software
author: Operation-Secret
selftext:
Hi everyone, so I am a game developer by profession and I have been working on this stylized character generator and sculpting  desktop software. I made it for myself, I use it in my own games, mainly because I was really tired of paying for so many different monthly subscriptions, especially when I am not using them on a day to day basis. I was thinking, will people be interested in a tool like this? People can use their own APIs so they only pay for their actual usage rather than monthly fees. 

I was thinking of making it available  as a one time purchase, I don't know at what price or anything, but at least it can help me get some funding to keep making games.

comments.author: MindlessAd4611
comments.body:
Damn that’s awesome!   
Must’ve been quite fun to build (: 

Care to share a bit about the tech stack?

replies.author: Operation-Secret
replies.body:
Yeah, I just kept adding features to it. I kind of realised I normally have to jump around too many softwares, so just kept adding all the necessary ones.

For the image gen part it using gemini and for 3d I am using the tripo3d api. I tried with local models, but my computer is not high end enough to handle them, maybe in the future.

The ui  is in flutter, mainly cause I am familiar with it, and it has good interoperability with C++ libraries and frameworks. Other than that if I ever think of making a web app it will be easier, flutter is cross platform.

comments.author: d-czar
comments.body: That’s really cool. Nice work.  If you’re going this far you should add rigging and animation.  There are APIs for those now too, and they’ll just keep getting better. I might pay for a tool like this if you had those.

replies.author: Operation-Secret
replies.body:
Yeah, I have been thinking about that. I was thinking of making it a seperate thing, u know similar to how adobe had mixamo fuse for the character generation stuff and then there's maxiamo animate, the web app, where rigging and animation can be done.

Obviously, I don't want to make web apps, but two seperate softwares. That it will be easiyfor me to maintain the code base as well.

replies.author: d-czar
replies.body: But the whole point is it’s better for user too do it all in one app.

replies.author: Operation-Secret
replies.body: Yes, that is true. I have been contemplating on that. It would be easier to just have everything in one place instead of jumping around different softwares.

comments.author: Traditional_Twist707
comments.body: sounds like a cool tool, I've been using a mix of tools like blueprintbot and framer for similar projects, but it's always good to see a new option pop up. I'm curious about how your generator will evolve and what features you're planning next.
